scope.game_manager: No GameManager persistence code was needed: it remains the runtime owner of currency, which is already collected/restored by Dungeon3D's existing run snapshot path.
scope.bridge_rule: Only export_fate_snapshot/import_fate_snapshot were added to FateCardGameBridge; existing Bridge functions were preserved.

snapshot_contract.backward_compatibility: Missing fate_run_state or unsupported version safely clears/ignores fate state; existing inventory/equipment/world restore remains available. Invalid numeric, type, orientation, unknown-card, malformed-rule and malformed-trigger data is rejected without applying it.
no_replay: no key grant or soul transaction
snapshot_contract.ownership: Weapon fate runtime state is keyed by the existing permanent weapon_instance_id and is restored only into currently equipped real instances; no ghost source or new ownership is created.
snapshot_contract.new_run: TowerDescent3D successful extraction carry removes fate_run_state; existing FateCardGameBridge.reset_run_state/reset_world_fate_state lifecycle clears temporary fate.

interfaces.signature: static func is_fate_snapshot_number(value: Variant, minimum: float, maximum: float, integer := false) -> bool
static func read_fate_snapshot_fields(value: Variant, defaults: Dictionary, signed_fields: Array = []) -> Dictionary

interfaces.purpose: Clear stale fate runtime trees before real equipment hydration
Export character modifiers, counters, used flags, blessing timers and per-instance weapon runtime state
Validate and restore character/per-instance runtime state without replaying effects
Embed fate state into the existing runtime_player_state_v2 snapshot
Export future world rules, temporary keys, room idempotency/queues, exploration and trigger counters
Validate and restore world fate state without re-rolling or re-registering
Export applied stable cards, orientations, effect snapshots and fixed pending rewards
Rehydrate cards from stable IDs/presets without applying or charging
Do not carry temporary fate state into a new run after successful extraction

assertions: HP and soul do not duplicate
character modifiers, blessing elapsed/stacks and kill counters survive
used flags and environment trigger counters survive
Fool fixed pending reward preserves stable ID/orientation/currency cost
weapon growth/overheat/Queen temporary state and model shot state survive
new-run reset clears cards, pending rewards, world rules and weapon temporary state
legacy snapshot without fate version safely defaults
verification.isolation: APPDATA and LOCALAPPDATA were isolated under outputs/fate_completion_20261008/persistence; no real save was touched.

documentation.registry: docs/v0.1/feature_registry.json adds verify_fate_resume_completion under FATE-RULES and SAVE-RUN; scripts/run_verification_suite.sh assigns it to core_scenes.
documentation.doc_gate_note: Existing project documentation/asset gate debt remains; this handoff does not claim the whole project gate is green.
